subject: Market surge signal — pricing moves & model releases (QBR prep / OKR check-ins)
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Market surge signal — this week

Team — quick heads-up ahead of QBR prep: field and partner signals show two concurrent moves that matter for our OKRs (revenue velocity + platform differentiation). Summary below with proposed actions. Please read once and flag owners in replies.

1) Pricing pressure: OpenModelOps announced an across-the-board list-price cut for hosted endpoints (approx -18%) targeted at mid-market SHs; their docs call out "predictable token pricing" and a new reserved-capacity credit for long-running inference. Field reports two active RFPs (one is Atlas Retail, see below) that now expect price parity.

2) Model release: a widely-cited OSS model (GMX-3-small) was released with aggressive quantized runtimes that claim similar quality at ~1/3 the token cost on A100-like hardware. Early perf tests look plausible for low-latency use cases.

Potential impact: if both moves propagate, our Hosted SKU unit economics could see compression in mid-market deals and our model-differentiation narratives for latency/cost will need tightening. This directly touches OKR-RV2 (reduce time-to-first-byte for generators) and OKR-COST1 (platform unit cost targets).

Proposed actions (short, concrete):
- Slides for QBR: 2 slides (market moves + impact matrix). Owner: Laura. Due: Mon EOD 11/29.
- Tactical pricing playbook note for field + AE enablement (include committed-tier offsets): Owner: Karthik. Due: Tue 11/30 morning.
- Field confirmation: validate two affected deals (Atlas Retail flagged). Owner: Marissa (please forward the Atlas thread).
- Quick perf validation: Research to run a 24h perf/quality test on GMX-3-small -> ops to estimate cost delta; will coordinate separately.

Attachments: heatmap and raw field rows attached. Link to shared Drive below.

Ask: Reply with "I own" on the item(s) you will take. If you think we should escalate to execs for a special competitive credit approval, note that in reply.

Thanks —
Markus
Markus Klein
